displayAddress: Hallmark Tower, 6 Cheetham Hill Road, Manchester, Lancashire, M4
description:
This stunning brand new apartment is part of the Hallmark Tower Development. The apartment consists of a fully furnished 2 bedroom, open plan kitchen/lounge, private balcony and a secure private parking area.
The development includes a concierge service as well as luxurious and comfortable communal lounge spaces as well as an communal open roof terrace. The development it just a few minutes walk from Manchester Victoria train station and 1 mile from Manchester Piccadilly.

If you are looking for a comfortable, fresh next home to live, this apartment will be suitable for you.
